goal: kb/_self/token-efficiency.md has a Model call sites section naming each model constant and agent file with its role, model, caps, what it decides and whether a rule or index could decide it, with the evidence and the command behind each figure

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import ast, re
want = []
for f, names in (('bl_dispatch', ['DEFAULT_MODEL']), ('census', ['HAIKU_MODEL', 'STEP_MODELS', 'DISPATCH_MODEL']), ('factdiff', ['JUDGE_MODEL']),
                 ('kb_ask', ['READER_MODEL']), ('kbask', ['MODEL']), ('ql_distill', ['HAIKU_MODEL']), ('ql_research', ['RESEARCH_MODEL'])):
    t = ast.parse(open('_tools/' + f + '.py', encoding='utf-8').read())
    have = {n.targets[0].id for n in t.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name)}
    want += [f + '.' + n for n in names if n in have]
import glob
want += [p for p in sorted(glob.glob('.claude/agents/*.md')) if re.search(r'^model:', open(p, encoding='utf-8').read(), re.M)]
t = open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
i = t.find('## Model call sites'); assert i >= 0, 'no Model call sites section'
j = t.find('\n## ', i + 3); s = ' '.join(t[i:j if j > 0 else len(t)].split())
miss = [w for w in want if w not in s]
print('call sites the section does not name:', miss); sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
